payload.package: i5b is an ENGINE-BEHAVIOUR increment, not a new distributable. The package is the versioned source set: engine/loop.ts (default provisioning, worktree routing, local-machine override + start-initial), engine/tools.ts (se_loop_start description) + the loop.ts comment + se.guidance-worktrees + the 3 framing-state notes (docs), and the two new acceptance tests (tests/i5b-worktrees-live.test.ts, tests/i5b-e2e.test.ts). Baselined by git; i5b runs on trunk as the bootstrap (the owner commits + pushes). Version 2.0.0-bootstrap unchanged - a behaviour increment within the bootstrap line.
